scope: The actual shell and rendered body: all 16 presets, the reported seed, and five dimensional extremes unless --case selects a subset. Identity plus eight wave samples, or bind only with --bind-only. Structural gates: welded closure, directed winding, connectedness, positive volume, nonzero area, stored skin assignments, neutral export identity, and seam continuity. Supplied/transported-normal disagreement is diagnostic: both omit deformation-gradient effects. With --check-facing, each flagged face is tested for exterior/interior generalized winding0/1 and proper nonadjacent triangle intersections. Shared-vertex contacts and coplanar overlaps are excluded; this is not a proof of absence of all self intersections. Color subdivision is suppressed only during deformation checks.
